headline: Nikita Kucherov's current, former teammates react to trade request: 'A tough day'
take:
The Athletic reports that Nikita Kucherov's current and former teammates reacted to his trade request, with one calling it "A tough day." The outlet's summary notes he assisted on the Lightning's first three goals in a 5-4 shootout loss to Nashville on Saturday.

Our numbers say the Lightning would be giving up a player who is still driving play. So far this season, Kucherov has 4 goals and 16 assists in 14 games and plays 21 minutes a night. TBL controls 59% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) at five-on-five with him on the ice, and the team's share improves by about 5 percentage points when he plays. His goals sit just under what his chances predict (4 scored against 4.42 expected), so his production is not a fluke. Last season he scored 44 goals and 130 points, and nothing in his early line suggests a drop. For TBL, a 9-3-2 team with 55% of the expected goals, losing him would hit a contender, which is why the reaction matters.
